poll.tooManyOptions: This server allows at most {max} poll options.
poll.badDuration: That doesn't look like a valid duration (try "1h", "30m", "2h30m").
poll.notFound: That poll could not be found.
poll.notOwner: Only the poll's creator or a moderator can do that.

giveaway.badDuration: That doesn't look like a valid duration (try "1h", "1d").
giveaway.badChannel: I can't post in that channel — check my permissions.
giveaway.notFound: That giveaway could not be found.
giveaway.notEndedYet: That giveaway hasn't ended yet — end it first, then reroll.
giveaway.noEntries: There were no eligible entries to draw from.

suggest.notConfigured: The suggestion box hasn't been set up yet. Ask a staff member to run /suggestions setup.
suggest.channelUnavailable: The suggestions channel isn't available right now — ask a staff member to check it.

suggestions.setupDone: Suggestions will now be posted to {channel}.
suggestions.alreadyThatStatus: That suggestion already has that status.

announce.badChannel: I can't post in that channel — check my permissions.
announce.notFound: That scheduled announcement could not be found.

remind.badChannel: I can't post in that channel — check my permissions.
remind.notFound: That reminder could not be found.
remind.notOwner: Only the reminder's owner or a moderator can do that.

event.badChannel: I can't post in that channel — check my permissions.
event.notFound: That event could not be found.

tag.disabled: Tags are turned off on this server.
tag.badName: Tag names are 1-32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, "-" or "_" (must start with a letter or number).
tag.exists: A tag named `{name}` already exists. Use /tag edit to change it.
tag.limit: This server has reached its limit of {max} tags. Delete one before creating another.
tag.noContent: A tag needs some content or a non-empty embed.
tag.created: Tag `{name}` created. Members can use it with `/tag show {name}`.
tag.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes the tag `{name}` (used {uses} times). Its audit history is kept.
tag.listEmpty: No tags yet. Staff can create one with `/tag create`.
tag.triggerSet: Tag `{name}` will now reply when a message {mode} "{phrase}" ({where}).
tag.triggersOffConfig: Note: keyword triggers are switched off in this server's community config (`tags.triggersEnabled`). The tag still works with `/tag show`.
tag.triggersNeedIntent: Note: keyword triggers need the Message Content intent, which is not enabled on this bot. The tag still works with `/tag show`.

sticky.set: Sticky message set in {channel}. It re-posts at most once every {cooldown}s.
sticky.notFound: There is no sticky message in {channel}.
sticky.listEmpty: No sticky messages yet. Run /sticky set in a channel to add one.
sticky.limit: This server already has the maximum of {max} sticky messages. Remove one first.
sticky.empty: Give the sticky some text or an embed title/description.
sticky.badChannel: Pick a text or announcement channel I can post in.
sticky.disabled: Sticky messages are turned off for this server (community → sticky.enabled).

publish.added: New messages in {channel} will now be published automatically.
publish.listEmpty: No channels are auto-published yet. Use /channelauto publish add.
publish.includeBotsOn: Messages from other bots and webhooks are published too.
publish.notAnnouncement: That isn't an announcement channel — only announcement channels can be published.
publish.missingManageMessages: ⚠️ I don't have Manage Messages in {channel}, so only my own messages will be published there. Grant it to publish everyone's.
publish.limit: You can auto-publish at most {max} channels.

thread.added: Every post in {channel} now gets its own thread named `{name}` (auto-archives after {archive}).
thread.listEmpty: No auto-thread rules yet. Use /channelauto thread add.
thread.limit: You can have at most {max} auto-thread rules.
